فِدْرَةٌ A piece of flesh-meat: (M, K:) or a compact piece thereof: (As, T, S, O:) or a piece of cold, cooked, flesh-meat: (T: [mentioned in the TA as from the M:]) and a piece of anything: (TA:) pl. فِدَرٌ. (T, TA.) ―
-b2- A lump of dates [compacted together]: (M:) or a large lump of dates compacted together; as also فِنْدِيرٌ and فِنْدِيرَةٌ, (TA in art. فندر.) ―
-b3- A piece of a mountain: (T, K:) or an overtopping, or an overhanging, or a projecting, piece of a mountain. (M.) See also فَادِرَةٌ. ―
-b4- And A portion of the night. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
